plugin.name: Vetta Ego
plugin.description: Let the agent use the ego browser — your own logged-in sites included — and make it the default for browser work and web app testing.
skill.browser.name: Vetta Ego
skill.browser.description: Open and operate websites, fill forms, sign in, take screenshots, extract page data and test web apps in the ego browser.
